settings.title: Born from the Field
settings.content: Atlas Dovy was founded by Mel, a lifelong Pacific Northwest naturalist with a sketchbook always in her back pocket. Every design begins with time spent in the field — watching, listening, sketching.

settings.title: Rooted in the Places We Love
settings.content: We partner with regional land trusts and wildlife organizations to protect the ecosystems that inspire our designs. 1% of every sale goes directly to conservation.
